asset_set: Questionnaire Q3 option 1 — Starting an online business

art_style.reference: Match src/assets/1.1.png and 1.2.png — unDraw-style full-body edu characters
art_style.fill: solid flat color blocks with minimal cel shade
art_style.mood: energetic startup-hustle vibe — approachable small-business launch, not a corporate boardroom
forbidden: readable text, shipping labels, or currency symbols

riasec_accent.use: phone growth-arrow icon, blazer lapel piping

riasec_secondary.use: box corner star sticker, shoe accent

color.background: transparent — faint grey decorative circles allowed at 15% opacity

character.face: minimal — two dot eyes, confident smile, no detailed nose
character.diversity_note: unique cast per slot — distinct hairstyle, skin tone, and outfit from prior slots

pose.stance: full body, standing, one hip forward, confident weight shift
pose.action: holding a small shipping box under one arm while raising a phone in the other hand showing an upward growth-arrow icon

top.garment: cropped blazer over a plain tee

subject.scene_narrative: A young woman stands confidently holding a small taped shipping box under one arm while raising a phone showing a coral growth-arrow icon in the other — a full-body flat vector figure capturing the DIY energy of launching a small online shop, in the same style language as the approved references.
subject.hero_prop: smartphone with a warm cream screen showing a simple coral upward growth-arrow icon and small bar shapes
supporting_props: small taped shipping box with a gold star sticker on the corner
roll of packing tape tucked under arm
subject.environment: thin grey floor line only, two faint grey decorative circles behind figure — no office interior

composition.layout: figure left-of-center, phone raised right, balanced like 1.1.png
composition.thumbnail_test: silhouette of person + phone and box readable at 160px

generation.negative_prompt: face photograph, realistic skin pores, text, watermark, letter E, dollar sign, currency symbols, readable shipping label, border frame, sticker card, top-down POV hands only, white background fill, photorealistic, 3d render, cropped head, extra limbs

prompt_for_image_ai: Flat vector full-body illustration, 640x640, transparent PNG background. Style MUST match KursoKo reference assets 1.1.png and 1.2.png: unDraw-inspired edu character, thin 2px dark outline #2D2D2D, flat color fills, minimal dot-eye face. Confident college-age young woman, olive tan skin, sleek high ponytail, purple #4B2C7F cropped blazer with charcoal lapel and coral #FF8A65 piping over a plain tee, charcoal wide-leg trousers, sneakers with a gold accent stripe. She stands with one hip forward holding a small taped tan shipping box with a gold #FFD54F star sticker under one arm, while raising a smartphone in her other hand showing a warm cream screen with a simple coral upward growth-arrow icon, no readable text. A roll of packing tape peeks from under her arm. Thin grey floor line, faint grey decorative circles only — NO opaque background, NO text, NO letter, NO border frame. Subtle Enterprising RIASEC coral accent on phone icon and blazer trim. Energetic optimistic hustle energy, full head-to-feet visible.
